B9906

DISASSEMBLY OF POWER STEERING PUMP

1. CLAMP POWER STEERING PUMP IN VISE
   CAUTION:  Do not tighten the vise too tight.

2. REMOVE FRONT HOUSING SET BOLTS

3. REMOVE RESERVOIR TANK AND O-RING
   Remove the two reservoir tank set bolts, reservoir tank and
   O-ring.

B9908

4. REMOVE AIR CONTROL VALVE

5. MARK FRONT AND REAR HOUSING
   Mark these parts to ensure correct reassembly.

6. REMOVE FRONT HOUSING
   Using a plastic hammer, tap off the front housing.
   CAUTION:  Be careful that the vane plates, rotor and
   cam ring do not fall out.

Z5266 [Z0067]
